title: Understand startup and synchronization stages

summary.text: Before the blockchain is up to date, Daedalus shows three stages: verifying on-disk blockchain state, replaying the ledger from the on-disk blockchain, and syncing the blockchain.

problem.text: Daedalus is still on its loading or synchronization screen and the user wants to know what each stage means.

symptoms.text: Daedalus shows verifying, replaying or syncing and has not finished.

user_phrases.text: Daedalus is stuck on replaying ledger

daedalus.notes: Behavior read from the Daedalus 11.6.0 release notes and the 11.6.0 tag source. Check a newer release before relying on it for a later version.

causes.claim: The available evidence does not establish one cause.

diagnostics.action: Daedalus Diagnostics, in the Help menu, shows the sync percentage and whether the Cardano node is syncing.

resolutions.action: If syncing takes longer than you want, Daedalus Diagnostics offers Mithril Sync, which restores verified chain data to speed it up.
If part of the blockchain data stored on the computer is missing, Daedalus says so and offers to rebuild it.

expected_outcome.text: The user follows the behavior the cited sources describe and knows where to ask for help if it does not resolve the problem.

do_not: Never disclose recovery phrases, seed words, private keys or spending passwords.
Do not delete, reset or move wallet data using generic instructions.
escalate_when: The symptom persists after the safe diagnostic steps, or funds appear at risk.

evidence.rationale: Release notes, tagged source and portal pages directly state the behavior; this is source inspection, not runtime testing.

faq.reason: Common support topic with a short answer that every cited source supports.
